test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ELEPHANT is written as MTMBSKCJ and LEOPARD is written as TMVBKEN. How will PANTHER be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c862ea9c33a633c54bfcf4c329c66d9a52118504f28cbfbfdf760e12f52cc05.png] 

The logic followed here is:

ELEPHANT is written as MTMBSKCJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea87aaca3a141743157ca72cb3710207fce125be6cc429baa9e271dbc9467a65.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6f0f98dcce3a7e5e1c0f818391289212e2093040ef27d7e5b244a0f637da823.png] 

LEOPARD is written as TMVBKEN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/355c013eb5087486a2e98a5c795fb560bfda04562604a214c4541fb081de8d8f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47eb165b212fa3f50c339ebe19542e65baa267b77efc168de382692d97bd0872.png] 

Similarly, **PANTHER** will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca929a9f1946d7db79b15a5862798dc4c5b100a78f28e205255dc51646d7aa8f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bee21a1fd31a5f6b11543724d8e3d66a50f2f949b8d2d516a6d77d5bc1de446.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"BKCJSME".**
